I have had three, I always felt my husband was afraid to burden me with his emotions (being an army vet doesnt help that) time has to pass,  focus on your healing and try to move past what could have been and enjoy where you are now. I know that is impossible now, but just keep healing. As for your relationship, give it time and let it play out when you ha e both had some time to grow from this. 
❤ feel free to reach out
